mapper.select: SELECT l.id, e.warehouse_id, l.sku_code, CASE WHEN l.reserved_delta != 0 AND l.quantity_delta = 0 THEN 'RESERVED' WHEN l.quality = 'DEFECTIVE' THEN 'DAMAGED' ELSE 'AVAILABLE' END AS bucket, CASE WHEN l.quantity_delta < 0 OR (l.quantity_delta = 0 AND l.reserved_delta < 0) THEN 'OUT' ELSE 'IN' END AS direction, ABS(CASE WHEN l.quantity_delta != 0 THEN l.quantity_delta ELSE l.reserved_delta END) AS quantity, l.before_quantity, l.after_quantity, e.id AS posting_id, e.event_no AS posting_no, l.id AS posting_item_id, e.event_type AS posting_type, e.source_type, e.source_id, e.source_no, e.reason AS remark, e.operator_id AS create_by, e.occurred_at AS create_time, l.location_id, loc.location_code, l.counterpart_location_id, target.location_code AS counterpart_location_code, l.quality, l.quantity_delta, l.reserved_delta, l.before_reserved, l.after_reserved FROM wms_inventory_event_line l JOIN wms_inventory_event e ON e.id = l.event_id LEFT JOIN wms_location loc ON loc.id = l.location_id AND loc.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN wms_location target ON target.id = l.counterpart_location_id AND target.deleted = 0 WHERE l.id = #{id}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type IN ('INBOUND_PUTAWAY','RETURN_PUTAWAY','STOCKTAKE_GAIN') AND l.quantity_delta > 0 THEN l.quantity_delta ELSE 0 END), 0) AS in_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type IN ('SHIP','DECREASE','STOCKTAKE_LOSS','SCRAP') AND l.quantity_delta < 0 THEN -l.quantity_delta ELSE 0 END), 0) AS out_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.reserved_delta > 0 THEN l.reserved_delta ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reserve_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.reserved_delta < 0 THEN -l.reserved_delta ELSE 0 END), 0) AS release_quantity FROM wms_inventory_event e JOIN wms_inventory_event_line l ON l.event_id = e.id WHERE e.occurred_at >= CURRENT_DATE
AND e.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(e.occurred_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type IN ('INBOUND_PUTAWAY','RETURN_PUTAWAY','STOCKTAKE_GAIN') AND l.quantity_delta > 0 THEN l.quantity_delta ELSE 0 END) AS in_quantity, SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type IN ('SHIP','DECREASE','STOCKTAKE_LOSS','SCRAP') AND l.quantity_delta < 0 THEN -l.quantity_delta ELSE 0 END) AS out_quantity FROM wms_inventory_event e JOIN wms_inventory_event_line l ON l.event_id = e.id WHERE e.occurred_at >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
AND e.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} GROUP BY DATE(e.occurred_at) ORDER BY DATE(e.occurred_at)

SELECT e.id, e.event_no AS posting_no, e.warehouse_id, e.event_type AS posting_type, e.source_type, e.source_id, e.source_no, e.occurred_at AS biz_time, e.occurred_at AS post_time, 'COMPLETED' AS status, e.reason AS remark, COUNT(DISTINCT l.sku_code) AS sku_count, SUM(ABS(CASE WHEN l.quantity_delta != 0 THEN l.quantity_delta ELSE l.reserved_delta END)) AS total_quantity FROM wms_inventory_event e JOIN wms_inventory_event_line l ON l.event_id = e.id WHERE e.id = #{id}
GROUP BY e.id
